concerns.text: T001 and T002 are both tagged [P] and listed as parallel, but T002's abort logic reads "abort loudly (raise DataFetchError) if unavailable and the deviation is not ratified" — the ratification artifact (data/provenance/spec_plan_deviation.json and the PLAN-DEVIATION doc) is written by T001. If T002 runs before T001 completes, the ratification check reads a nonexistent file and the parallel-safe tag is wrong. Either add 'Depends on: T001' to T002, move the deviation-ratification artifacts into T002, or have T002's check not depend on a T001-produced file.
